item.title: AI Field Notes: Discussing AI Sentiment, Future, and Issues | Tech Punk #1
item.description: In Episode 1 of Tech Punk, I share my views and questions about AI, covering personal and widespread sentiment, making predictions on the future of AI and whether the bubble will burst, and dissecting the issues of AI.

item.title: A Lifetime in Tech: From First Computer to PhD to Industry | Tech Punk #0
item.description: This is my story, of how I got into tech, learned to code, and went on the internet back in the late 90s. Yes, I'm that old! I'll talk about high school, college, PhD & research, going into the industry, and having a mental breakdown & burn out.
